description: Load component pipeline template rows before template step rows so ordered steps can reference the parent template.
Reusable templates should include pre_llm, llm, post_llm, and control_flow stages unless the task intentionally omits one.
Step component references must be preserved in the step body even when the referenced active component or candidate is not loaded yet.
Generated templates should enter the database as reviewable templates before becoming tenant-visible off-the-shelf products.
Templates and each ordered step should be eligible for keyword, label, vector, and facet indexing after load.
Cost-aware templates should carry enough metadata to join against model pricing, runtime pricing, cache assumptions, and expected media or token volume.
